narrative.overview: Care Companion joins an ambient family photo frame to a clear household care ledger. Family imagery carries the patient view; paper-white operational surfaces organize the caretaker view.

rules.name: State Has a Color
rules.body: Green confirms, coral asks for attention, blue dispatches, and amber marks schedules.

rules.name: Across the Room
rules.body: Patient prompts and decisions remain readable from several feet away.

dos: Do let real family imagery dominate idle receiver states.
Do keep patient actions large, labeled, and voice-supported.
donts: Don't make the receiver feel like a settings dashboard.
Don't use color as the only care-state carrier.
Don't introduce elastic motion or decorative glow.
